newsitem.title: USA: Brother convicted of aiding World Trade Center bomber.
newsitem.headline: Brother convicted of aiding World Trade Center bomber.

text.p: A Manhattan federal jury on Wednesday convicted a New Jersey man of trying to help his brother escape arrest in connection with the February 1993 bombing of the World Trade Centre.

Mohammad Abouhalima, 33, was convicted of the one count for driving his brother, Mahmud, to John F. Kennedy International Airport on March 2, 1993 knowing that he had participated in the bombing that killed six and injured more than 1,000.

Mahmud was arrested on March 10, 1993 in his native Egypt after fleeing New York. He was convicted in March 1994 with three other militant Moslems for the bombing and is serving a 240-year prison sentence.
The Egyptian-born Mohammad Abouhalima, a cab driver who lives in Avenel, N.J., faces a possible maximum sentence of up to 15 years in prison.
